title: Claim review decision
description: Structured determination and claims-manager approval form.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: claim-review-decision
  title: Claim review decision
  description: Structured review and approval record for the insurance claim workflow.
  version: 1.0.0
  source:
    system: ladder
    sourceId: claim-review-decision
    sourceVersion: 1.0.0
spec:
  role: approval
  pages:
    - id: determination
      title: Claim determination
      sections:
        - id: decision
          title: Decision
          fields:
            - id: coverage-position
              name: coverage_position
              label: Coverage position
              dataType: string
              widget: radio
              required: true
              allowedValues: [accepted, reservation-of-rights, denied, pending]
              ontologyPropertyRef: coverage.coverage_position
            - id: recommended-reserve
              name: recommended_reserve
              label: Recommended reserve
              dataType: number
              widget: number
              minimum: 0
              ontologyPropertyRef: claim_adjustment.recommended_reserve
            - id: rationale
              name: rationale
              label: Determination rationale
              dataType: string
              widget: textarea
              required: true
              minLength: 40
              ontologyPropertyRef: coverage.coverage_analysis
              span: 2
            - id: open-items
              name: open_items
              label: Open items
              dataType: array
              ontologyPropertyRef: claim_adjustment.open_items
              span: 2
            - id: manager-approved
              name: manager_approved
              label: Claims manager approval
              dataType: boolean
              widget: checkbox
              required: true
  submissionSchema: {}
